findings.title: Stock report loads every sale detail row into memory
findings.impact: A tenant with a year of sales exhausts API memory and takes the service down for every tenant.
findings.remediation: Aggregate in SQL with GroupBy/Sum and page the result.

findings.title: Product search runs a LIKE '%term%' scan without an index
findings.impact: Search latency grows linearly with catalogue size; large tenants time out.
findings.remediation: Add a full-text index or a prefix search.

findings.title: Dashboard widgets are fetched sequentially
findings.evidence: await this.loadSales(); await this.loadStock(); await this.loadExpenses();
findings.impact: Dashboard takes three round trips longer than needed.
findings.remediation: Load the widgets in parallel with forkJoin.
